architecture.summary: The weekly organization sweep now clears organization_name when it deletes the tenant of an organization that WorkOS no longer has (2 November 2026): the row of an absent organization loses its organization name, while its service name, which can hold the slug of that name, stays for the record of the deleted service. The fleet command delete keeps the organization name, so the repair "delete, then request" gives the revived row the same service name; a row that the sweep deleted has no name, so its revive gets the name of the ID alone. The shared removal of tenants takes the cause of the removal, organization-absent for the sweep and operator for the fleet command; the fleet store contract of tenants gains markDeletedWithoutOrganizationName, one more guarded UPDATE of the SQL adapter with the same start state and service as the delete of the operator (internalInterface). The data retention of the account deletion procedure and the recovery outcome of a revive change (sensitiveBehavior). No column, migration, setting, grant, component, container, public module, dependency, or Mermaid view changes; the prose of the tenant registry view records the two delete statements and the cause.
